numerical_failure.observed_behavior: Non-metric MDS (metric=False) in sklearn.manifold: the stress loss increases after a couple of SMACOF iterations (e.g. it 1 stress 33534.27419788723, it 2 stress 33605.33211344484, breaking at iteration 2), the algorithm stops early, and the returned stress does not correspond to the returned embedding but to the previous iteration; separately, IsotonicRegression can raise out-of-bounds errors from machine precision issues, and smacof with the dissimilarity matrix from issue 26999 raises ValueError: Input contains NaN.
numerical_failure.expected_behavior: The stress should decrease monotonically across SMACOF iterations; the isotonic regression should not run before the first SMACOF iteration (SMACOF update first); the upper-triangular disparities should be copied into the lower triangle; the returned stress should correspond to the returned embedding; IsotonicRegression should use out_of_bounds="clip"; and smacof should run without errors (No errors) on the issue 26999 input.

In issue #27028 stress goes from 33534.27419788723 at it 1 to 33605.33211344484 at it 2, and the run breaks at iteration 2 with that stress. The PR body states that 'the loss increases after a couple of iterations (which should not happen)'.
Issue #27028 also reports that the non-metric run reaches a stress about 2x lower than the default optimization run (33605 versus the default run), which the reporter calls 'very fishy'.
Issue #16846 (cited in PR #30514): the returned stress does not correspond to the returned embedding but to the previous iteration; the fix moves the stress computation after the SMACOF update.
Stress-1 formula from doc/modules/manifold.rst: sqrt(sum_{i<j}(hat d_ij - d_ij(Z))^2 / sum_{i<j} d_ij(Z)^2), where the normalized stress is computed on the embedding Z.
Doctest in _mds.py: the expected stress changed from np.float64(0.0012...) to np.round(stress, 5).item() == 0.00128, with embedding coordinates for a 3-point example given to 5 decimals.
